verdict.rationale: Shortwave documents per-thread team comments, where @mentioning a teammate grants access to that one email, plus shared AI Snippets. These are adjacent collaboration features, not shared inboxes or shared accounts where a whole team sees the same conversation state. Community feedback from a Front user notes Shortwave lacks Front-style multi-inbox and doubts Bundles could replace Team Inboxes.

support.subject: As a team-lead, my team works shared inboxes together — shared accounts or team channels where everyone sees the same conversation state
